name: Kenya
imageAlt: Kenya Red Cross responders reviewing field data on a tablet
shortDescription: Primary operational headquarters across all 47 counties, managing full-suite digital products, GIS mapping, and early warning systems.
fieldNote: Every county has a branch feeding the same data layer, so a flood alert in Tana River and a cash payout in Turkana run on one system.

name: Somalia
imageAlt: Drought-affected settlement receiving mobile cash assistance
shortDescription: Cross-border drought tracking, displaced population cash assistance platform deployment, and satellite damage assessment.
fieldNote: Payments reach displaced households by phone, and satellite imagery scores shelter damage before a team can reach the site.

name: Uganda
imageAlt: Community health volunteers logging cases at a border post
shortDescription: Regional cross-border epidemic surveillance and flood early action collaboration with Uganda Red Cross Society.
fieldNote: Case reports cross the border faster than the outbreak does, and Karamoja drought signals trigger action before harvests fail.

name: Tanzania
imageAlt: Coastal community mapping session with local volunteers
shortDescription: Joint coastal flood mapping, cholera surveillance dashboard, and community mHealth training programs.
fieldNote: Storm surge models run against coastal settlement maps, and health questions get answered in Swahili on any phone.

name: Ethiopia
imageAlt: River gauge inspection along a highland basin
shortDescription: Shared hydrological data pipelines along Omo and Dawa river basins for anticipatory flood warnings.
fieldNote: River gauges upstream give downstream communities a head start measured in days rather than hours.

name: South Sudan
imageAlt: Health survey being recorded on an offline mobile device
shortDescription: Sudd wetland flood inundation mapping and offline mobile health survey tool deployment.
fieldNote: Survey tools work with no signal at all and sync the moment a team is back within range.

name: Rwanda
imageAlt: Drone pilot preparing a mapping flight over terraced hills
shortDescription: Technical knowledge exchange on drone imagery processing and emergency dispatch automation.
fieldNote: Drone imagery turns into landslide risk maps within hours of a flight, and dispatch picks the nearest team automatically.

name: Democratic Republic of Congo
imageAlt: Epidemic response team at a community screening point
shortDescription: Ebola & Marburg epidemic surveillance data integration with regional Red Cross outbreak dashboards.
fieldNote: Community reports and lab results land in the same dashboard, so response teams stop working from two versions of the truth.

name: South Africa
imageAlt: Partner workshop for the Africa Localisation Hub
shortDescription: Consortium partner hub for the Africa Localisation Hub platform.
fieldNote: A shared build so national societies adapt tools locally instead of commissioning the same system ten times over.

name: Gambia
imageAlt: Volunteers registering on the membership management system
shortDescription: Operational deployment of the Volunteer and Membership Management System (VMMS).
fieldNote: Volunteer records, training history and deployment status live in one register instead of a dozen spreadsheets.
